items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Do not clear public exposure or security-sensitive releases. The security baseline covers 59 managed sites, but fleet-doctor is unavailable, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Risk severity: high for release and launch decisions due to material unknowns; no active vulnerability is established. Permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing compliance boundaries.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue, or conduct outreach.
